row_mode_definition.worked_solution: Observable age-appropriate explanation only when explicitly requested; no hidden reasoning target.
row_mode_definition.hint_level_1: Initial guidance: one useful orientation question, no result.
row_mode_definition.hint_level_2: More specific relation or representation, without computed answer.
row_mode_definition.hint_level_3: Next actionable step/scaffold with unfilled computation; no full solved target or final answer.

completion_definition.research_pack: All495originalcorecases and1980pairedchatrows authored, independent exact+semantic checks done, meaningful supplementarycases included, provenance/split grouping/content hashes complete.
completion_definition.registered_nodes_covered: At least3case sets per165node, not proof all subskills/difficulty/real-world outcomes are exhausted.
completion_definition.current_source_confirmed: 2018 annex outcomes previously read; latest legal currency must be separately rechecked before current2026certification.
completion_definition.legacy_source_confirmed: 59observed historical topics; full2006annex and allolderprograms stillpending.
completion_definition.visual_practical: Textguidance/hypotheticaldescription never counts as observedimage or actualinstrument competency.

current_regrouping_bounds.g1: no carry/borrow, values and answer within99 (conservative subset of0–100)
current_regrouping_bounds.g3: <=2nonconsecutive regrouping, five digit column operands and results; kg->g<=99000; area uses at most one multi-digit multiplier
current_regrouping_bounds.g5_hard_columns: Explicit capstone research extension reviewing prior natural-number skills; hard cascading borrow not asserted as a new g5 current outcome

exclusion_audit.bounded_equivalence: Associative/commutative +/*; ordered -/division/remainder. Conservative published pilot result-expression linkage. No algebraic cancellation or universal semantic equivalence claim.
exclusion_audit.training_replay_policy: V3 train mathematical cases allowed with CORRECTED_REPLAY provenance; V3 val/challenge and selection pilots always excluded. Freshval additionally excludes all V3train cases.
